Hi Samir —

Thanks again for moving the Private deployment forward. Before we flip any switches on Redwood's side, can we confirm the items below? We want to avoid last-minute chokepoints during the activation window.

Prereqs we need from MedicoSys by EOD Monday (2025-06-23):
- Service account list with emails + intended roles (attach CSV)
- KMS key ARN (customer-managed) and contact for key rotation: who owns keys on your side
- Allowlist ranges for egress and any NAT gateway IPs we need to expect
- Firewall rules that will allow inbound callbacks from the control-plane IPs (we'll supply IP list once you confirm)

Proposed smoke-test windows (pick one):
- Tue 2025-06-24 02:00-04:00 UTC
- Tue 2025-06-24 14:00-16:00 UTC (preferred for overlap with our infra team)

Attachments: smoke-test-plan.docx (initial), templates/service-accounts-template.csv

If you can confirm the service account CSV and the KMS ARN, Ben will run a quick provisioning dry-run on our staging VPC and then we'll schedule the smoke test.

Thanks — I can be on the call during the preferred window.

— Lauren
